#| echo: false

import json
from pathlib import Path

data_dir = Path("../data")
with open(data_dir / "metrics.json") as f:
    metrics = json.load(f)

def pct(x, digits=1):
    return f"{100 * x:.{digits}f}%"

def signed_pct(x, digits=1):
    return f"{100 * x:+.{digits}f}%"

def signed_pp(x, digits=1):
    return f"{100 * x:+.{digits}f} pp"

def num(x, digits=3):
    return f"{x:.{digits}f}"

def fmt_exact_p(p):
    if p >= 1:
        return "1.000"
    if p < 0.001:
        return f"{p:.2e}"
    return f"{p:.3f}"

def val(path, default="[metric pending]"):
    cur = metrics
    for part in path:
        if isinstance(cur, dict) and part in cur:
            cur = cur[part]
        else:
            return default
    return cur

def interval_s(row, key="coverage_delta"):
    low_key = key + "_ci_low"
    high_key = key + "_ci_high"
    if low_key not in row and key == "coverage_delta":
        low_key = "coverage_ci_low"
        high_key = "coverage_ci_high"
    return f"{signed_pp(row[key])} [{signed_pp(row[low_key])}, {signed_pp(row[high_key])}]"

def rate_ci_s(cell):
    return f"{pct(cell['rate'])} [{pct(cell['ci_low'])}, {pct(cell['ci_high'])}], n={cell['denominator_n']:,}"

leave_nasa_artifact_delta = next(
    r for r in metrics["original_paper_substance_schema_delta_summary"]["rows"]
    if r["task"] == "leave_NASA_out"
    and r["comparison"] == "artifact_bookkeeping_as_used_minus_clean_original"
)["coverage_delta"]
largest_recent_label_delta = metrics["original_paper_substance_schema_delta_summary"]["largest_abs_coverage_delta"]["coverage_delta"]
largest_recent_label_task = metrics["original_paper_substance_schema_delta_summary"]["largest_abs_coverage_delta"]["task"]
adaptive_rows = metrics["shift_adaptive_comparator_comparator_summary"]["rows"]
adaptive_by_task = {row["task"]: row for row in adaptive_rows}
adaptive_recovered = sum(1 for r in adaptive_rows if r["adaptive_meets_target"])
adaptive_total = len(adaptive_rows)
task_label_map = {
    "main_heldout": "Main",
    "leave_CALCE_out": "LCAL",
    "target_recalibrated_CALCE": "TCAL",
    "leave_NASA_out": "LNAS",
    "target_recalibrated_NASA": "TNAS",
    "leave_Oxford_out": "LOxf",
    "target_recalibrated_Oxford": "TOxf",
}
main_cell_block = metrics["scoped_method_repair_tasks"]["main_heldout"]["methods"]["persistence_anchor_protocol_mondrian_cp"]
main_cov_s = pct(main_cell_block["coverage"])
main_ci_low_s = pct(main_cell_block["cell_block_ci_low"])
main_ci_high_s = pct(main_cell_block["cell_block_ci_high"])
main_width_s = num(main_cell_block["mean_width"])
main_n = f"{main_cell_block['n']:,}"
target_coverage_s = pct(metrics["main_baseline_target_coverage"], 0)
main_q_level = main_cell_block["q_level"]
source_experiment_count = len(metrics["_meta"]["source_experiments"])
main_selected_method = metrics["main_baseline_selected_method"]
scoped_tasks = metrics["scoped_method_repair_tasks"]
main_split_design = metrics["scoped_method_repair_main_split_design"]
main_split_partitions = main_split_design["partitions"]
source_cycle_rows_s = f"{main_split_design['source_cycle_rows']:,}"
eligible_cycle_rows_s = f"{main_split_design['eligible_cycle_rows']:,}"
excluded_first_rows_s = f"{main_split_design['excluded_first_rows']:,}"
main_selected_method_s = "persistence-anchor Mondrian conformal diagnostic"
full_features = metrics["ablation_study_conditions"]["full_features"]
full_features_method_s = "persistence-anchor standard conformal diagnostic"
full_features_cov_s = pct(full_features["selected"]["coverage"])
full_features_width_s = num(full_features["selected"]["mean_width"])
without_prev = metrics["ablation_study_conditions"]["without_prev_soh"]
without_prev_method = without_prev["selected_method"]
without_prev_method_s = "gradient-boosting domain-Mondrian conformal diagnostic"
without_prev_cov_s = pct(without_prev["selected"]["coverage"])
without_prev_width_s = num(without_prev["selected"]["mean_width"])
without_prev_delta_cov_s = signed_pp(without_prev["delta_vs_full"]["coverage"])
without_prev_delta_width_s = num(without_prev["delta_vs_full"]["mean_width"])
du_false_safe_s = rate_ci_s(metrics["reliability_audit_decision_utility_ci"]["leave_CALCE_out"]["cqr_gradient_boosting"]["soh_threshold_0.70"]["false_safe_per_actual_unsafe"])
du_false_alarm_s = rate_ci_s(metrics["reliability_audit_decision_utility_ci"]["leave_CALCE_out"]["cqr_gradient_boosting"]["soh_threshold_0.70"]["false_alarm_per_actual_safe"])
du_threshold_080_s = "0.80"
serviceability_thresholds = sorted(metrics["hard_regime_audit_thresholds"])
serviceability_thresholds_s = ", ".join(f"{threshold:.2f}" for threshold in serviceability_thresholds)
adaptive_recovered_tasks_s = ", ".join(
    task_label_map[t] for t in metrics["shift_adaptive_comparator_comparator_summary"]["tasks_recovered_by_adaptive"]
)
adaptive_unrecovered_tasks_s = ", ".join(
    task_label_map[t] for t in metrics["shift_adaptive_comparator_comparator_summary"]["tasks_not_recovered_by_adaptive"]
)
adaptive_point_failure_recovered = sum(
    1 for r in adaptive_rows
    if r["adaptive_meets_target"] and r["standard_coverage"] < metrics["main_baseline_target_coverage"]
)
adaptive_point_failure_recovered_s = str(adaptive_point_failure_recovered)
adaptive_point_failure_summary_s = (
    "one standard point-coverage failure"
    if adaptive_point_failure_recovered == 1
    else f"{adaptive_point_failure_recovered} standard point-coverage failures"
)
adaptive_lower_bound_recovered_rows = [
    r for r in adaptive_rows
    if r["adaptive_meets_target"]
    and r["standard_cell_ci_low"] < metrics["main_baseline_target_coverage"]
    and r["adaptive_cell_ci_low"] >= metrics["main_baseline_target_coverage"]
]
adaptive_lower_bound_recovered_s = str(len(adaptive_lower_bound_recovered_rows))
adaptive_lower_bound_summary_s = (
    "no lower-bound shortfall"
    if len(adaptive_lower_bound_recovered_rows) == 0
    else (
        "one lower-bound shortfall"
        if len(adaptive_lower_bound_recovered_rows) == 1
        else f"{len(adaptive_lower_bound_recovered_rows)} lower-bound shortfalls"
    )
)
adaptive_lower_bound_recovered_tasks_s = ", ".join(
    task_label_map[r["task"]] for r in adaptive_lower_bound_recovered_rows
)
adaptive_leave_nasa_row = next(r for r in adaptive_rows if r["task"] == "leave_NASA_out")
adaptive_main_row = adaptive_by_task["main_heldout"]
adaptive_lcal_row = adaptive_by_task["leave_CALCE_out"]
adaptive_main_standard_s = pct(adaptive_main_row["standard_coverage"])
adaptive_lcal_standard_s = pct(adaptive_lcal_row["standard_coverage"])
adaptive_main_delta_s = signed_pp(adaptive_main_row["coverage_delta_adaptive_minus_standard"])
adaptive_lcal_delta_s = signed_pp(adaptive_lcal_row["coverage_delta_adaptive_minus_standard"])
adaptive_main_standard_low_s = pct(adaptive_main_row["standard_cell_ci_low"])
adaptive_main_adaptive_low_s = pct(adaptive_main_row["adaptive_cell_ci_low"])
adaptive_leave_nasa_standard_low_s = pct(adaptive_leave_nasa_row["standard_cell_ci_low"])
adaptive_leave_nasa_adaptive_low_s = pct(adaptive_leave_nasa_row["adaptive_cell_ci_low"])
leave_nasa_raw_smd_s = num(metrics["round4_schema_repair_shift_diagnostics"]["leave_NASA_out"]["max_abs_standardized_mean_diff"], 2)
leave_nasa_common_smd_s = num(metrics["round4_schema_repair_shift_diagnostics"]["leave_NASA_out_common_feature_schema"]["max_abs_standardized_mean_diff"], 2)
largest_recent_label_delta_s = f"{100*abs(largest_recent_label_delta):.1f} pp"
largest_recent_label_delta_signed_s = signed_pp(largest_recent_label_delta)
lnas_recent_label_delta_s = f"{100*abs(next(r for r in metrics['original_paper_substance_schema_delta_summary']['rows'] if r['task'] == 'leave_NASA_out' and r['comparison'] == 'recent_label_reference_common_no_recent_minus_prev_soh_reference')['coverage_delta']):.1f} pp"
du_threshold_s = "0.70"
leave_nasa_artifact_delta_s = f"{100*abs(leave_nasa_artifact_delta):.1f} pp"
leave_nasa_artifact_delta_signed_s = signed_pp(leave_nasa_artifact_delta)
fpa_negative_failure_count = len(metrics["fpa_repair_negative_diagnostic_failure_list"])
main_cqr_width_ratio_s = num(
    metrics["round4_schema_repair_baseline_alignment"]["main_heldout"]
    ["coverage_aligned_baseline_view"]["cqr_gradient_boosting"]["width_ratio_vs_persistence"],
    2,
)
leave_nasa_ngboost_false_safe_s = rate_ci_s(
    metrics["reliability_audit_decision_utility_ci"]["leave_NASA_out"]
    ["ngboost_normal_cqr"]["soh_threshold_0.80"]["false_safe_per_actual_unsafe"]
)
no_recent_tasks = metrics["original_paper_substance_tasks"]
no_recent_common_main = no_recent_tasks["main_heldout"]["schemas"]["common_cycle_no_recent_schema"]["metrics"]
no_recent_common_leave_nasa = no_recent_tasks["leave_NASA_out"]["schemas"]["common_cycle_no_recent_schema"]["metrics"]
no_recent_common_leave_oxford = no_recent_tasks["leave_Oxford_out"]["schemas"]["common_cycle_no_recent_schema"]["metrics"]
no_recent_clean_main = no_recent_tasks["main_heldout"]["schemas"]["clean_original_no_recent_schema"]["metrics"]
no_recent_common_main_s = pct(no_recent_common_main["coverage"])
no_recent_common_leave_nasa_s = pct(no_recent_common_leave_nasa["coverage"])
no_recent_common_leave_oxford_s = pct(no_recent_common_leave_oxford["coverage"])
no_recent_clean_main_s = pct(no_recent_clean_main["coverage"])

# --- Schema-artifact determination: coverage-lens headline + false-acceptance signed diagnostic ---
from statistics import NormalDist
substance_decision_rules = metrics["original_paper_substance_decision_rules"]
substance_multiplicity = metrics["original_paper_substance_multiplicity_control"]
substance_tasks_raw = metrics["original_paper_substance_tasks"]
artifact_rows = substance_decision_rules["rows"]
artifact_by_task = {r["task"]: r for r in artifact_rows}
lnas_bundle_fs_rule = artifact_by_task["leave_NASA_out"]
lnas_bundle_fs_delta_s = signed_pp(lnas_bundle_fs_rule["fs_delta"])
lnas_bundle_fs_threshold_s = lnas_bundle_fs_rule["fs_threshold"].replace("soh_threshold_", "")
lnas_bundle_fs_exact_p_s = fmt_exact_p(lnas_bundle_fs_rule["fs_exact_pvalue"])
lnas_bundle_fs_n_s = f"{lnas_bundle_fs_rule['fs_denominator_n']:,}"
artifact_family_n = substance_multiplicity["family_n"]
artifact_alpha_s = num(substance_multiplicity["alpha"], 2)
import math as _math
_ba = substance_multiplicity['bonferroni_alpha']
_be = int(_math.floor(_math.log10(_ba)))
_sup = str.maketrans("0123456789-", "⁰¹²³⁴⁵⁶⁷⁸⁹⁻")
artifact_bonferroni_alpha_s = f"{_ba/10**_be:.1f}×10{str(_be).translate(_sup)}"
artifact_bonferroni_z_s = num(NormalDist().inv_cdf(1 - substance_multiplicity['bonferroni_alpha'] / 2), 1)
artifact_coverage_min_pp = int(round(100 * substance_decision_rules["artifact_delta_min_abs"]))
decision_min_denominator = metrics["round4_schema_repair_decision_utility_policy"]["min_denominator"]
artifact_total_count_s = str(len(artifact_rows))
# Headline schema artifact = COVERAGE lens only (robust criterion: CI excludes 0 and |delta| >= 3pp)
coverage_artifact_keys = substance_decision_rules["artifact_positive_tasks"]
coverage_artifact_tasks_s = ", ".join(task_label_map[t] for t in coverage_artifact_keys) if coverage_artifact_keys else "none"
coverage_artifact_count_s = str(len(coverage_artifact_keys))
negative_control_failure_keys = substance_decision_rules["negative_control_failures"]
negative_control_failure_tasks_s = ", ".join(task_label_map[t] for t in negative_control_failure_keys) if negative_control_failure_keys else "none"
_tcal_control_cells = substance_tasks_raw["target_recalibrated_CALCE"]["schema_deltas"]["negative_control_clean_original_minus_zero_control"]["false_safe_rate_delta_a_minus_b"]
_tcal_control_nonnull = [
    (threshold, cell)
    for threshold, cell in _tcal_control_cells.items()
    if cell["ci_low"] > 0
    or cell["ci_high"] < 0
    or cell.get("boundary_exact_significant", False)
]
assert len(_tcal_control_nonnull) == 1
_tcal_control_threshold, _tcal_control_cell = _tcal_control_nonnull[0]
tcal_control_threshold_s = _tcal_control_threshold.replace("soh_threshold_", "")
tcal_control_false_acceptance_s = (
    f"{100 * _tcal_control_cell['delta']:+.1f} pp "
    f"[{100 * _tcal_control_cell['ci_low']:+.1f}, "
    f"{100 * _tcal_control_cell['ci_high']:+.1f}]"
)
schema_claim_allowed = bool(substance_decision_rules["claim_allowed"])
# False acceptance reported as a SIGNED diagnostic (not a headline trigger)
fs_degrading_keys = substance_decision_rules["fs_safety_degrading_tasks"]
fs_improving_keys = substance_decision_rules["fs_safety_improving_tasks"]
fs_degrading_count_s = str(len(fs_degrading_keys))
def _fs_desc(keys):
    parts = []
    for k in keys:
        r = artifact_by_task[k]
        thr = r["fs_threshold"].replace("soh_threshold_", "") if r.get("fs_threshold") else "?"
        direction = r.get("fs_direction", "signed")
        direction = {
            "safer": "risk-decreasing",
            "safety-degrading": "risk-increasing",
        }.get(direction, direction)
        parts.append(f"{task_label_map[k]} ({100*r['fs_delta']:+.0f} pp [{100*r['fs_ci_low']:+.0f}, {100*r['fs_ci_high']:+.0f}], n={r['fs_denominator_n']:,}, {direction} at the {thr} SOH threshold)")
    return "; ".join(parts) if parts else "none"
fs_degrading_desc_s = _fs_desc(fs_degrading_keys)
fs_improving_desc_s = _fs_desc(fs_improving_keys)
# Degenerate boundary flips (false acceptance deterministically 0<->1 under a schema)
fs_flip_keys = []
for r in artifact_rows:
    for thr in r.get("fs_degenerate_thresholds", []):
        cell = substance_tasks_raw[r["task"]]["schema_deltas"]["artifact_bookkeeping_as_used_minus_clean_original"]["false_safe_rate_delta_a_minus_b"][thr]
        if abs(cell["delta"]) >= 0.5:
            fs_flip_keys.append(r["task"])
            break
fs_flip_tasks_s = ", ".join(task_label_map[t] for t in fs_flip_keys) if fs_flip_keys else "none"

# --- Absolute all-acceptable collapse: surface the deterministic false-acceptance=1.0 cells, not only the schema delta ---
_lnas_node = substance_tasks_raw["leave_NASA_out"]
_lnas_raw_du = _lnas_node["schemas"]["as_used_exp010_schema"]["metrics"]["decision_utility_ci"]
_lnas_clean_du = _lnas_node["schemas"]["clean_original_no_recent_schema"]["metrics"]["decision_utility_ci"]
_lnas_prev_du = _lnas_node["schemas"]["common_cycle_prev_soh_reference_schema"]["metrics"]["decision_utility_ci"]
_lnas_fs_delta = _lnas_node["schema_deltas"]["artifact_bookkeeping_as_used_minus_clean_original"]["false_safe_rate_delta_a_minus_b"]
lnas_bundle_fs_cells_s = str(
    _lnas_fs_delta[lnas_bundle_fs_rule["fs_threshold"]]["effective_cell_count"]
)
lnas_bundle_fs_raw_rate_s = pct(
    _lnas_raw_du[lnas_bundle_fs_rule["fs_threshold"]]["false_safe_per_actual_unsafe"]["rate"]
)
lnas_bundle_fs_clean_rate_s = pct(
    _lnas_clean_du[lnas_bundle_fs_rule["fs_threshold"]]["false_safe_per_actual_unsafe"]["rate"]
)

_lcal_node = substance_tasks_raw["leave_CALCE_out"]
_lcal_raw_du = _lcal_node["schemas"]["as_used_exp010_schema"]["metrics"]["decision_utility_ci"]
_lcal_clean_du = _lcal_node["schemas"]["clean_original_no_recent_schema"]["metrics"]["decision_utility_ci"]
_lcal_fs_delta = _lcal_node["schema_deltas"]["artifact_bookkeeping_as_used_minus_clean_original"]["false_safe_rate_delta_a_minus_b"]
_lcal_eligible = [
    (key, cell) for key, cell in _lcal_fs_delta.items()
    if cell["denominator_n"] >= decision_min_denominator
]
_lcal_fs_key, _lcal_fs_cell = max(_lcal_eligible, key=lambda item: abs(item[1]["delta"]))
lcal_bundle_fs_delta_s = signed_pp(_lcal_fs_cell["delta"])
lcal_bundle_fs_threshold_s = _lcal_fs_key.replace("soh_threshold_", "")
lcal_bundle_fs_raw_rate_s = pct(_lcal_raw_du[_lcal_fs_key]["false_safe_per_actual_unsafe"]["rate"])
lcal_bundle_fs_clean_rate_s = pct(_lcal_clean_du[_lcal_fs_key]["false_safe_per_actual_unsafe"]["rate"])
lcal_bundle_fs_n_s = f"{_lcal_fs_cell['denominator_n']:,}"
lcal_bundle_fs_cells_s = str(_lcal_fs_cell["effective_cell_count"])
lcal_bundle_fs_discordant_s = str(_lcal_fs_cell["paired_cell_nonzero_count"])
lcal_bundle_fs_exact_p_s = fmt_exact_p(_lcal_fs_cell["paired_cell_sign_pvalue"])

def _thr_num(k):
    return float(k.replace("soh_threshold_", ""))

def _fmt_thr_range(keys):
    if not keys:
        return "none"
    nums = sorted(_thr_num(k) for k in keys)
    return f"{nums[0]:.2f}–{nums[-1]:.2f}" if len(nums) > 1 else f"{nums[0]:.2f}"

def _fs_rate(du, k):
    return du[k]["false_safe_per_actual_unsafe"]["rate"]

_lnas_thr_keys = sorted(_lnas_raw_du.keys(), key=_thr_num)
_lnas_raw_allsafe = [k for k in _lnas_thr_keys if _fs_rate(_lnas_raw_du, k) == 1.0]
_lnas_clean_allsafe = [k for k in _lnas_thr_keys if _fs_rate(_lnas_clean_du, k) == 1.0]
lnas_allsafe_raw_thresholds_s = _fmt_thr_range(_lnas_raw_allsafe)
lnas_allsafe_clean_thresholds_s = _fmt_thr_range(_lnas_clean_allsafe)
_lnas_allsafe_ns = [_lnas_raw_du[k]["false_safe_per_actual_unsafe"]["denominator_n"] for k in _lnas_raw_allsafe]
lnas_allsafe_n_min = min(_lnas_allsafe_ns)
lnas_allsafe_n_max = max(_lnas_allsafe_ns)
lnas_restored_max_fs_s = pct(max(_fs_rate(_lnas_prev_du, k) for k in _lnas_thr_keys))
lnas_fullfeat_cqr_080_s = pct(metrics["reliability_audit_decision_utility_ci"]["leave_NASA_out"]["cqr_gradient_boosting"]["soh_threshold_0.80"]["false_safe_per_actual_unsafe"]["rate"])
lnas_fullfeat_ngboost_080_s = pct(metrics["reliability_audit_decision_utility_ci"]["leave_NASA_out"]["ngboost_normal_cqr"]["soh_threshold_0.80"]["false_safe_per_actual_unsafe"]["rate"])
# Name the schema that collapses to all-acceptable at the excluded flip threshold (derived, not assumed)
_lnas_flip_thrs = [k for k in _lnas_thr_keys if abs(_lnas_fs_delta[k]["delta"]) >= 0.5]
fs_flip_threshold_s = _fmt_thr_range(_lnas_flip_thrs)
if _lnas_flip_thrs and _fs_rate(_lnas_raw_du, _lnas_flip_thrs[0]) == 1.0:
    fs_flip_schema_s = "the raw as-used bookkeeping schema"
elif _lnas_flip_thrs:
    fs_flip_schema_s = "the cleaned no-recent schema"
else:
    fs_flip_schema_s = "one schema"
